description:
Pedal into the world of Stranger Things with this special edition Max bike. Modeled after the bike Max Mayfield rides in Season 3 of the show, this bike features tons of rad Mongoose BMX-design elements straight out of the 1980’s. This includes replica frame and fork to the classic Mongoose pad set. Plus, the Max bike is loaded with show-inspired details, including the two rear axle pegs (where Eleven rides along), a headlamp for exploring the Upside-Down, and more! Whether on the way to school, off to grab the high score at the arcade, or on a mission to save friends, fans will be able to bring the world of the Netflix Original Series Stranger Things to life with this special edition bike.
Available exclusively at Target.
